title: rubiscoNdist
intro:
The ’rubiscoNdist’ component calculates the rubisco N distribution for photosyn-
thesis in the canopy.

sections.name: exp
sections.desc: Boegh et al.(2002) rubisco N-distribution model in the canopy for photosynthesis.

attrs.name: kn
attrs.doc:
Extinction coefficient of nitrogen in the canopy, kn = 0.713 (De Pury &Far-
     quhar, 1997)

sections.text:
Boegh et al.(2002) rubisco N-distribution model in the canopy for photosynthesis.
   Used by photosynthesis Farquhar N-dist (see 64.1, page 345) .
  < exp (kn 0.713 []) >
    kn: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.713)
     Extinction coefficient of nitrogen in the canopy, kn = 0.713 (De Pury &Far-
     quhar, 1997)

sections.name: expr
sections.desc: expr rubisco N-distribution model in the canopy.

attrs.name: value
attrs.doc:
Expression that evaluates to the relative rubisco N intesity where 1 is the
     value in top of the canopy.

attrs.name: f photo
attrs.doc:
Fraction of photosynthetically active N in canopy. According to (Boegh et al.,
     2002) f photo = 0.75. However, non-functional N is already substracted from
     leaf-N in the cropN std module, therefore f photo = 1.0 as default.
